scope: Corollary 1.2 (Deformation and smooth topology) of the manuscript “Global Spherical Shells on Minimal Surfaces of Class VII” (preprints/Global-Spherical-Shells-on-Minimal-Surfaces-of-Class-VII-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 060 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d441e45f773bce9f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, and put b = b2(X). There is a small one-parameter deformation X → ∆ over a disk about 0, with X0 ≃ X, such that every nonzero fiber is obtained from a primary Hopf surface by exactly b successive point blowups. The centers may be infinitely near. Moreover, π1(X) ∼ = Z, X ∼ =or (S1 × S3 )# b CP 2 , where the second is an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism for the complex orientation of X.
